author: Sadrom
body:
Map Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/xafx6uc2t0xzb8y/Sadrom.rar
Map Images: http://imgur.com/a/pgyWN

Hello, this is my first map creation. I hope everyone likes it's simplicity. It seems like the community has liked simple maps like ternio and rendezvous so I decided to see how many people would like a simple map, but with hidden treasure and tnt.

Map Information

Game play: Destroy the Monument
Team Size: 10-20 per team(Can be changed, no big deal)
Monuments: 2 per team
Teams: Blue vs. Red
Starting Armor: Leather tunic, leather pants, leather boots, and a chain helmet. All armor includes blast prot 2.
Starting Inventory: 1 stone sword, 1 infinity bow, 1 arrow, 32 steak, 2 golden apples, 4 stacks of wooden planks, 1 stack of glass, 16 bottles 'o enchanting, and 1 block of lapis.

Creators: Sadrom, Kazon, PACKERBACKER33
Special thanks to: alexanderjoe, Myv, and iMan

replies.author: Limidi
replies.body:
Hi Sadrom.

For this map, Imo the map needs to be larger, and it is a little boring. Add some more map space, so you can add more structures. That would make for some amazing gameplay! Also, we have a lot of DTM maps already. I like the idea, and it could blossom into something amazing. Email me at liam.dietrich@me.com if you would like some more tips. But in the meantime, im gonna give it a -1 since it is not a very playable map at this point. good Luck!

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Your map has been denied for the following reasons.

-Way too small and simple: The map needs to have more of a body to it.

-Monument places- At the moment with the map size the monuments are too far from the map. If this is edited it might be better but for now that is the issue.

You may resubmit this map after those edits have been applied to the map.
